import os
import sys
import time

mode = sys.argv[1]
if mode == 'pidfd-failure':
    time.sleep(30)
    raise SystemExit(0)
if mode not in ('timeout-descendant', 'escaped-descendant'):
    raise SystemExit(2)
read_end, write_end = os.pipe()
child = os.fork()
if child == 0:
    os.close(read_end)
    if mode == 'escaped-descendant':
        os.setsid()
    os.write(write_end, b'R')
    os.close(write_end)
    time.sleep(30)
    os._exit(0)
os.close(write_end)
if os.read(read_end, 1) != b'R':
    os._exit(3)
os.close(read_end)
print('READY %d %d' % (os.getpid(), child), flush=True)
if mode == 'escaped-descendant':
    os._exit(0)
time.sleep(30)
